desc: The SD root's t6040-net-up runs as an inittab ::once: entry but WiFi/sshd were not confirmed up on the maxcpus=1 boot (no address reported). Verify and fix: check wpa_supplicant associates from the baked /etc/wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.conf, udhcpc gets a lease, sshd starts with the 98-byte authorized_keys, and ntpd corrects the clock. Success = the machine is reachable over ssh straight after a cold boot with no console interaction, which removes the serial tether from every future userspace iteration.
author: claude
